name: HIPAA Privacy Rule: purpose, authorization, minimum necessary, de-identification and disclosures
description: HIPAA Privacy Rule: purpose, authorization, minimum necessary, de-identification and disclosures. From the Shio policy pack specification; draft, not reviewed.
limits: Draft and unreviewed. Planned controls are listed for coverage and not enforced.

frameworks.title: HIPAA Privacy Rule (45 CFR Part 164, Subpart E)

controls.title: Every request declares a purpose from the registry
controls.requirement: Every request declares a purpose from the registry; uses and disclosures are allowed only as the Rule permits.

controls.title: Purposes that need written authorization (marketing
controls.requirement: Purposes that need written authorization (marketing, sale of PHI, psychotherapy notes) have a matching, unexpired authorization.

controls.title: An authorization relied on is signed
controls.requirement: An authorization relied on is signed, dated, names the information, recipient, purpose and expiry, carries the revocation statement and is not revoked.

controls.title: Minimum necessary
controls.requirement: Minimum necessary: only fields on the purpose's allow-list are sent.

controls.title: Minimum-necessary exceptions are explicit and narrow
controls.requirement: Minimum-necessary exceptions are explicit and narrow; nothing else is exempt.

controls.title: A whole-record request carries a written justification
controls.requirement: A whole-record request carries a written justification.

controls.title: Each caller has a role
controls.requirement: Each caller has a role, and each role a list of PHI categories it may read.

controls.title: PHI goes only to parties with a business associate agreement on file
controls.requirement: PHI goes only to parties with a business associate agreement on file, that do not train on inputs, and are approved for the data classes sent.

controls.title: Where the purpose needs no PHI
controls.requirement: Where the purpose needs no PHI, identifiers are de-identified (tokenised) before sending, and a second detector pass holds anything left.

controls.title: Re-identification codes are not derived from identifiers and the key stays outside the mod
controls.requirement: Re-identification codes are not derived from identifiers and the key stays outside the model boundary.

controls.title: A limited data set has a current data use agreement with the recipient
controls.requirement: A limited data set has a current data use agreement with the recipient.

controls.title: Research names exactly one pathway
controls.requirement: Research names exactly one pathway, with its proof on file.

controls.title: Disclosures to a personal representative need a representative record and respect state ru
controls.requirement: Disclosures to a personal representative need a representative record and respect state rules on minors.

controls.title: Restrictions and confidential communications the organisation agreed to are honoured
controls.requirement: Restrictions and confidential communications the organisation agreed to are honoured.

controls.title: Opt-outs and fundraising or marketing preferences are applied
controls.requirement: Opt-outs and fundraising or marketing preferences are applied.

controls.title: Disclosures to the individual go through the right-of-access path with identity verificati
controls.requirement: Disclosures to the individual go through the right-of-access path with identity verification.

controls.title: Every non-TPO disclosure is logged for accounting and kept six years
controls.requirement: Every non-TPO disclosure is logged for accounting and kept six years.

controls.title: Amendment requests are routed to a person and tracked to a decision
controls.requirement: Amendment requests are routed to a person and tracked to a decision.

controls.title: The Notice of Privacy Practices is current and covers AI use where required
controls.requirement: The Notice of Privacy Practices is current and covers AI use where required.

controls.title: Documentation
controls.requirement: Documentation, policies and training records are kept six years.

controls.title: Workforce training
controls.requirement: Workforce training, a sanctions policy and a named privacy official exist.

controls.title: Safeguards for PHI in prompts
controls.requirement: Safeguards for PHI in prompts, logs, traces, caches and eval sets are no weaker than for production records.

controls.title: A harmful impermissible use opens a mitigation record
controls.requirement: A harmful impermissible use opens a mitigation record.

controls.title: Identity and authority are verified before disclosing outside the organisation
controls.requirement: Identity and authority are verified before disclosing outside the organisation.
